sourceReferences.apa7: Sano, M. (2006). Focus particle licensing: A case study of made, sae and demo in Japanese. Ritsumeikan Studies in Language and Culture, 17(2), 83–94.
sourceReferences.locator: PDF p. 83, §§0–1, lines 10–24: introduces まで・さえ・でも as focus particles and gives use roughly translatable as “even,” with example (1).
sourceReferences.supports: Supports only that these forms can share an “even”-like focus-particle use and the cited constructed example; it does not establish each entry’s full usage range, colloquial suggestion/minimization, or listed original examples.

semanticReview.method: Seguimiento de fuente primaria, ronda 1: lectura del artículo y la revisión anterior; búsqueda/cotejo de materiales gratuitos. Se conserva pendiente cualquier afirmación que no tenga una fuente primaria con localizador suficiente.
findings: Se distingue el まで de foco extremo del marcador de límite espacial/temporal, con análisis escalar y de expectativa.
